title: Robots and artificial intelligence
text: Fifty years ago, robots only existed in science fiction films. People used to imagine metal men who walked and talked like humans. Today robots are real, but most of them look nothing like those old films.

In the past, factories used to need thousands of workers to build a car. Now huge robotic arms do most of the work. They never get tired, and they can repeat the same movement millions of times with perfect precision.

Artificial intelligence, or AI, is different. It is not a machine with arms: it is software that can learn from examples. People used to write every instruction for a computer. Now we show an AI millions of examples and it learns to recognize faces, translate languages or even write texts.

AI is already part of our lives. It recommends videos, helps doctors to find diseases in X-rays and drives some cars. Many people did not use to trust machines, but now they talk to virtual assistants every day.

Of course, there are also worries. Some jobs will disappear, and AI can make mistakes. That is why experts say we need clear rules. Robots and AI are powerful tools, and humans have to decide how to use them.

grammar.title: Grammar: used to
grammar.rule: Use used to + verb for habits or situations in the past that are not true now. Negative: did not use to.
rows: They did not use to trust machines.
items: Factories ___ to need thousands of workers.
Many people did not ___ to trust machines.
